units.source_text: 此时月明如昼，旅舍浅显，月光照彻全室，

en.t: At this time the moon was as bright as day, and the travelers' lodging was so plain and exposed that moonlight shone through the entire room,

units.source_text: 躺着可以望见深夜的天空，

en.t: so that one could lie down and gaze up at the deep night sky,

units.source_text: 真所谓“终宵床底见青天”也。

en.t: truly like the saying, "all night long one sees the blue heavens from beneath the bed."

units.source_text: 看了西沉的月亮，有凄凉之感，

en.t: Looking at the moon sinking in the west, he felt a desolate sadness,

units.source_text: 源氏公子便自言自语地吟唱菅公“只是西行不左迁”之诗，

en.t: and Prince Genji softly recited to himself Sugawara no Michizane's poem, "I am only going west, not being demoted,"
